title: Universal Coordinate system + teleport
features:
Coordinate system + teleport
Insert - Open/Close
Sound menu
script:

-- soun
local function playUISound(id, volume)
    local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
    sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)
    sound.Volume = volume or 0.65
    sound.Parent = SoundService
    sound:Play()

    sound.Ended:Connect(function()
        sound:Destroy()
    end)

    task.delay(10, function()
        if sound.Parent then
            sound:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

local selectedLanguage = "en"
local languageSelected = false

local function T(key)
    return translations[selectedLanguage][key]
        or translations.en[key]
        or key
end

-- n1
local function applyLanguage()
    local panel = mainGui:FindFirstChild("MainPanel")
    if not panel then return end

    local header = panel:FindFirstChild("Frame")
    if header then
        local title = header:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
        if title then title.Text = T("title") end

        local minimize = header:FindFirstChild("TextButton")
        if minimize and not minimized then
            minimize.Text = T("minimize")
        end
    end

    -- base
    for _, obj in ipairs(panel:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("TextLabel") then
            if obj.Text == "ТЕКУЩЕЕ ПОЛОЖЕНИЕ"
                or obj.Text == "CURRENT POSITION" then
                obj.Text = T("current")
            elseif obj.Text == "КООРДИНАТЫ НАЗНАЧЕНИЯ"
                or obj.Text == "DESTINATION COORDINATES" then
                obj.Text = T("destination")
            elseif obj.Text == "СОХРАНЁННЫЕ ТОЧКИ"
                or obj.Text == "SAVED LOCATIONS" then
                obj.Text = T("saved")
            elseif obj.Text == "Система готова"
                or obj.Text == "System ready" then
                obj.Text = T("ready")
            elseif obj.Text == "Ожидание персонажа..."
                or obj.Text == "Waiting for character..." then
                obj.Text = T("waiting")
            end

        elseif obj:IsA("TextButton") then
            if obj.Text == "Взять мои координаты"
                or obj.Text == "Get my coordinates"
                or obj.Text == "Координаты übernehmen" then
                obj.Text = T("capture")
            elseif obj.Text == "ТЕЛЕПОРТИРОВАТЬСЯ"
                or obj.Text == "TELEPORT" then
                obj.Text = T("teleport")
            elseif obj.Text == "＋ ДОБАВИТЬ"
                or obj.Text == "+ ADD" then
                obj.Text = T("add")
            elseif obj.Text == "GO" then
                obj.Text = T("go")
            end

        elseif obj:IsA("TextBox") then
            if obj.PlaceholderText == "Название точки"
                or obj.PlaceholderText == "Location name" then
                obj.PlaceholderText = T("name")
            end
        end
    end
end

-- play bb
local function hookClickSound(buttonObject)
    if buttonObject and buttonObject:IsA("GuiButton") then
        buttonObject.Activated:Connect(function()
            playUISound(CLICK_SOUND)
        end)
    end
end

-- GUI
hookClickSound(mainGui:FindFirstChild("MainPanel")
    and mainGui.MainPanel:FindFirstChild("Frame")
    and mainGui.MainPanel.Frame:FindFirstChild("MinimizeButton"))

-- nn
local function connectActionSounds()
    for _, obj in ipairs(mainGui:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("TextButton") then
            local text = obj.Text
            if text == "ТЕЛЕПОРТИРОВАТЬСЯ"
                or text == "Взять мои координаты"
                or text == "＋ ДОБАВИТЬ"
                or text == "GO" then
                hookClickSound(obj)
            end
        end
    end
end

-- start
mainPanel.Visible = false
playUISound(MENU_SOUND, 0.8)

TweenService:Create(
    menuScale,
    TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Back,
        Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
    {Scale = 1}
):Play()

for index, info in ipairs(languageNames) do
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Name = "Language_" .. info.code
    b.LayoutOrder = index
    b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
    b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(37, 44, 61)
    b.BorderSizePixel = 0
    b.Text = info.name
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 248, 255)
    b.TextSize = 15
    b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    b.AutoButtonColor = false
    b.ZIndex = 22
    b.Parent = buttonsHolder

    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    c.Parent = b

    b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(65, 100, 165)
        }):Play()
    end)

    b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(37, 44, 61)
        }):Play()
    end)

    b.Activated:Connect(function()
        if languageSelected then return end
        languageSelected = true
        selectedLanguage = info.code

        playUISound(CLICK_SOUND, 0.8)

        applyLanguage()
        connectActionSounds()

        mainPanel.Visible = true

        --nn
        local mainScale = mainPanel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
        if mainScale then
            mainScale.Scale = 0.85
            TweenService:Create(
                mainScale,
                TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back,
                    Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {Scale = 1}
            ):Play()
        end

        local fade = TweenService:Create(
            menu,
            TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,
                Enum.EasingDirection.In),
            {BackgroundTransparency = 1}
        )

        TweenService:Create(
            menuScale,
            TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,
                Enum.EasingDirection.In),
            {Scale = 0.9}
        ):Play()

        fade:Play()
        fade.Completed:Wait()
        menu:Destroy()
    end)
end
